name: Erin
testimonial:
I had the pleasure of being tutored by Teacher Suegne for Physical Sciences in Grade 10 and 11, while my brother was also tutored by her for Mathematics in Grade 9. Throughout this time, she consistently demonstrated patience, dedication, and a genuine commitment to helping us understand and improve.

One of her greatest strengths is her ability to explain difficult concepts in a way that is easy to understand. She often used everyday examples to simplify complex ideas, which made the work much more relatable and helped me develop a stronger understanding of the concepts rather than simply memorising them.

I also felt very comfortable discussing the work with her and asking questions whenever I was unsure about something. She created an environment where I could openly identify and correct my mistakes without feeling uncomfortable or embarrassed.

She was also extremely helpful in providing additional resources to support my learning. These included past papers for practice, as well as summaries of the work that helped me revise and understand important concepts more effectively. These resources were particularly useful when preparing for tests and exams.

Another quality I appreciated was her adaptability. She was able to adjust her approach according to my individual needs and was always willing to assist whenever I had a question, regardless of the time of day.

Overall, I am very grateful for the support and guidance she provided to both my brother and me. 🌸
